thread:
Emily (support): Hi team — high-sev customer (acme-corp) reporting consistent 504s and 5xx on hosted inference in us-west-2 after a marketing blast. Started ~2024-03-08T18:12Z. Customer request id: req_0a1b2c3d. They say requests hit gateway and hang for ~10-30s then 504. Escalating, they are SLA-critical.

Maria (support): Attaching the example curl that reproduces it from our side: 
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{"model":"gpt-large","input":"short prompt"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Response: 504 Gateway Timeout, x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d.

Jonathan (SRE): Thanks. I see correlated autoscaler events in the cluster around that time. KEDA scaledobject shows many scale-up attempts but pods stayed in Pending for 20-40s. Posting trimmed events: 
```
Events:
  Normal  ScalingReplicaSet  35s  HorizontalPodAutoscaler scaled up replica set inference-deploy-abc from 2 to 6
  Warning FailedScheduling  32s  0/6 nodes are available: 6 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.
  Normal  Pulled  30s  Container image pulled
  Warning Unhealthy  25s  Readiness probe failed: timeout
```
Looks like model init (cold boot) + node provisioning causing queue.

Maria (support): Model init logs from affected pod (stderr): 
```
[2024-03-08T18:12:24Z] loading weights: 2.1GB
[2024-03-08T18:12:39Z] mmap: delayed pinning, waiting for gpudriver init
[2024-03-08T18:12:55Z] startupProbe timeout after 20s
```
So startupProbe timeout happening before model fully initializes.

Leo (ML): That model (gpt-large) has ~2GB checkpoint load on our platform per replica and typically 18-30s cold init on a warm node; on unprovisioned node it takes longer. We also see tokeniser and KV cache warmup.

Jonathan (SRE): KEDA config: scaledobject has cooldown=300s, pollingInterval=5s, minReplicaCount=1, maxReplicaCount=10. No prewarm configured. HPA target CPU-based. KEDA is reacting to queue backlog but node pool autoscaler takes ~20-40s to allocate GPUs. Net result: requests pile up and gateway returns 504.

sre-bot: alert: AUTOSCALE-LAG-5XX fired (threshold: average 5xx rate > 2% over 5m).

Maria (support): Repro steps I used to trigger: 
1) run 60 concurrent curl requests over 10s against acme tenant using a small script (attached).
2) Observe queued requests in api gateway and 504s when scaleup didn't finish.

Script (simplified): 
```
for i in {1..60}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gpt-large","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done
wait
```

Jonathan (SRE): Short-term mitigation: increase minReplicaCount to 2-3 for this tenant or route them to a reserved pool. Also bump startupProbe and readinessProbe timeouts and add a shorter startupProbe initialDelay to allow model init to finish. Medium-term: add prewarmed replicas (preWarmedReplicas) or use node auto-provisioning warm pools.

Leo (ML): Also recommend adding a quantized model variant (gpt-large-8bit) as automatic fallback for bursts; it initializes in ~8-12s. We can enable fallback routing by model tag.

Sam (AM): Customer is escalating — please provide ETA for a short-term fix and permission to move them to a reserved capacity for the next 24h. Ticket #RED-20240308-91.

Emily (support): Assigned: Jonathan + Maria to implement probe/timeouts + minReplica bump, Leo to prepare fallback model, Sam to coordinate reserved capacity approval. ETA for short-term changes: 60-90m?

Jonathan (SRE): Plan of action: 
- Now: increase startupProbe timeout from 20s to 90s for inference pods and set readinessProbe initialDelaySeconds=30 (owner: Maria).
- 15m: patch KEDA scaledobject to minReplicaCount=2 for tenant PVC label (owner: Jonathan).
- 30m: enable temporary routing rule to fallback model gpt-large-8bit for acme (owner: Leo).
- 60m: if still failing, move tenant to reserved capacity pool (owner: Sam).

infra-bot: deploy triggered: patch/inference/startupprobe-timeout-90s (ci job #4021).

Maria (support): Patching now, will report when rollout completes.

Jonathan (SRE): Post-patch observations: scaled up to 4 replicas, startupProbe no longer timing out, initial 5m 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 1.2%. Still seeing occasional 504s at peak QPS; holding on reserved capacity move for now.

Emily (support): Customer updated: they confirm 5xx reduced, performance acceptable for immediate needs. Leaving this thread open for follow-up retro on autoscale design.

Actions created: #INC-20240308-91 (owner: Jonathan) with follow-ups: add prewarm support, improve autoscaler heuristics for GPU coldstart, and create doc for recommended tenant configs for bursty workloads.

sre-bot: incident status -> mitigated (low).
